description:
## Objective

Add the supported AI basic and conversation learning paths.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U15`
Covers: `R1, R2, R4, R8; KTD1, KTD2, KTD4, KTD6, KTD8.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.8 (U8) — Add the example catalog harness must be complete; jido-07x.2 (U2) — Activate authoring and Covenant gates must be complete.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.18 (U18) — Reconcile offline AI benchmarks must be complete; jido-07x.19 (U19) — Port the AI live provider check must be complete.

## Files

Read AI baseline example groups `00_graph_first/**`, `01_basics/**`, and `02_conversations/**` at `2d3cac6700fcb850b632c2ce5f552ccfd0e5459e`. Exclude `99_proposed/**`. Add `examples/ai/**` and `test/examples/ai/**`. Change the manifest.

## Instructions

1. Port graph-first, basic Agent, tool, structured output, controls, streaming, request, composition, model helper, JSON, Session, and Thread examples.
2. Use deterministic local model fixtures.
3. Keep provider calls out of the example suite.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every baseline AI example has a manifest disposition.
- [ ] `99_proposed/**` is excluded with a reason.
- [ ] All ported AI examples pass without a provider key.

## Verification

- `mix test.examples test/examples/ai` exits with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.

comments.text: Completed in bf69a4d. Added 16 numbered offline AI lessons under examples/ai and 34 paired deterministic tests, plus the shared AI model fixture. Updated the example catalog and four jido_ai source-manifest dispositions: three baseline groups ported and 99_proposed excluded. Verification: focused AI/catalog/manifest 42 passed with 6 excluded; full example suite 260 passed; warnings-as-errors, format, links, diff check, and no lib or refs changes passed. Deferred assets: none for U15. Deviations: kept the required numbered chapter and lesson structure and adapted obsolete split-package APIs to the current graph-first APIs. Remaining blockers: none.

title: Port offline AI examples
